thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: high request error rate detected at edge-lon1 POP, threshold breached (5m avg > 4% 5xx). Escalating to oncall. Incident ID INC-2163.
raj.singh: I'm on it. got the page. Can someone confirm if it's widespread or single CDN edge?
maria.k: Looking at CDN health dashboards — spike in 5xx from edge-lon1 and latency up ~250ms for some prefixes. Other POPs normal.
zack_o: +1, I see repeated tcp retransmits and ~35-60% packet loss to the POP from monitoring probes.
raj.singh: Ok run quick traceroute from our probe -> lon1 and paste.
maria.k: traceroute output:
```
traceroute to edge-lon1 (52.48.12.34), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  1.123 ms  0.987 ms  1.045 ms
 2  100.64.1.1  12.3 ms  12.1 ms  12.4 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.100.9  45.6 ms  46.0 ms  46.1 ms
 5  52.48.12.34  48.3 ms  48.6 ms  48.5 ms
```
maria.k: note hop 3 shows * then path resumes, but packet loss more pronounced to the POP itself per probes.
zack_o: From our egress probes: ping loss to 52.48.12.34 40-60% (ICMP). TCP SYNs are failing intermittently, resulting in connection timeouts for customers behind that POP.
neteng-bot: Detected flaps on upstream carrier ASN 65001 for prefixes covering edge-lon1. Possible last-mile carrier issue. Ticket created with carrier: CAR-9987.
raj.singh: Customer impact: CDN requests proxied through edge-lon1 see 4xx/5xx rate increase and higher latencies. Region: UK (London) and surrounding geos. Which customers are affected?
customer-success: Affected customers reported: AcmeMedia (high traffic), FinOptima (sensitive latency), two regional e-com partners. CS has opened support tickets and flagged for SLA risk.
zack_o: Immediate mitigation plan:
- Shift traffic off edge-lon1 via CDN steering (set weight to 0) — temporary
- BGP withdraw for affected prefix from our side to force carrier reroute (if steering insufficient)
- If BGP changes needed, coordinate with neteng and carrier contact
- Keep oncall and CS updated
raj.singh: Maria, can you push a CDN steering change? Use existing runbook.
maria.k: Pushing steering change now -> setting weight=10% then 0% for lon1
```
# CDN CLI snippet
cdn steer update --pop edge-lon1 --weight 10
cdn steer update --pop edge-lon1 --weight 0
```
maria.k: Done. Monitoring now.
raj.singh: Observability — watch 5xx rate, latency P95, and SYN fail counts. zack, do you want to run a quick synthetic check?
zack_o: Running synthetics:
- Before steering: SYN failures ~18/min, 5xx rate 4.3%
- After steering start: SYN failures dropping to ~5/min, 5xx rate trending down to 1.1% after 90s
zack_o: Looks like steering helped. Keep it at 0% until carrier accepts CAR-9987 or we have root cause.
neteng-bot: Carrier responded: "We observe packet loss on last-mile fiber segment between LON-IX and carrier POP. NOC engaged, ETA initial fix 45-90m." (ticket CAR-9987)
raj.singh: Good. Let's prepare customer comms. CS: draft short notification: what happened, mitigation, ETA, impact, contact.
customer-success: Draft prepared: short message + link to status page. Will post once we have final ETA. Also offering SLA credits to FinOptima/AcmeMedia if they escalate.
devops_oncall: Handoff note — I'm tagged as next oncall in 60m. Raj, can you summarize actions for the handoff? I'll be on standby.
raj.singh: Handoff summary:
- Incident INC-2163 triggered by edge-lon1 last-mile packet loss to carrier ASN 65001
- Actions taken: CDN steering -> weight 0 (traffic rerouted), carrier ticket CAR-9987 opened, monitoring shows 5xx decreased from 4.3% -> ~0.9% after steering
- Current status: edge-lon1 traffic drained, carrier working on physical last-mile; synth checks OK to other POPs; customer CS notifications ready
- Next steps for oncall: monitor CAR-9987 updates, keep steering at 0% until carrier confirms stable or until we validate BGP changes; prep rollback to 10%/100% after confirmation
devops_oncall: ack, will monitor and take over if anything changes. Please ping me on PD if carrier gives update requiring action.
maria.k: Posting current metrics snapshot to the incident timeline. 5xx rate graph link: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2163/metrics
raj.singh: Add note to postmortem template: include timeline, root cause (carrier last-mile), mitigation (CDN steering), customer impact list, SLA exposure. We'll assign owners after stable.
zack_o: Quick follow-up: If carrier doesn't resolve in 90m, we may need to consider BGP withdrawal for affected prefixes (impactful, coordinate with neteng and infra leads).
neteng-bot: Carrier updated CAR-9987: "NOC found a degraded mux, spare scheduled, replacement ETA 70m."
customer-success: Posting customer notice now. Short + link to status + support contact.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: traffic steering applied, partial mitigation successful. Incident remains open. INC-2163. Assigned -> raj.singh (primary), devops_oncall (secondary).
raj.singh: Thank you team. I'll watch for carrier updates. If anyone sees re-escalation, ping PD and @devops_oncall.
devops_oncall: monitoring. I'll pick this up at handoff.
zack_o: leaving a quick shell snippet used to query SYN failures:
```
# query for SYN failures
kubectl logs -l app=probe --tail 200 | grep 'SYN_FAIL' | wc -l
```
maria.k: marking this thread for timeline reconstruction later. I'll keep logging all timestamps.
raj.singh: last note before handing off — retention: keep steering at 0% until carrier confirms fixed and we have <0.5% 5xx sustained for 10m.
devops_oncall: copy. taking over. ping me for anything urgent. :phone:
